datasets.caveat: User-confirmed one80-sweep uniform-memory leg plus one60-sweep disordered-memory leg,140 maximum per CSS component. Code-capacity adaptation of Relay Eq4, not circuit-paper reproduction. Both logical components count. Numerical backgrounds are fixed source NMS or parent training-only selected BP settings; no parent fresh outcome enters selection. Independent noise/memory streams and four disjoint stage seeds. All selected and ablation confirmations remain separate. This140 budget differs from prior32/128 studies. New latency excludes provenance hashing and is not directly comparable to older instrumented timings.
